::: {.ach-intro}
Every so often the citation counts get refreshed, and when a number crosses a line the system says so, in the register of a certain dungeon. Per-paper feats earn a themed box: a Flask for the biosocial work, Handcuffs for criminology, a Challenge Coin for first responders. Routine progress earns mockery. Each paper's tally sits on its hex in the [skill tree](skilltree.html) as a roman numeral, lower left, across from the impact pips.
:::
